Class LocalHostResolver

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.LocalHostResolver
public final class LocalHostResolver extends Object
Resolves the IPv4 address to advertise as java.rmi.server.hostname so that remote peers can open callback connections back to this JVM.

It deliberately avoids InetAddress.getLocalHost(): on Debian/Ubuntu the host name is mapped to the loopback alias 127.0.1.1 in /etc/hosts, which makes RMI export stubs pointing at an address the remote peer cannot reach. Both the server (App) and the RMI client share this resolver so the two ends behave identically across operating systems.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public static String resolve()
      Returns the address to publish via RMI.

      An explicit -D"java.rmi.server.hostname" override always wins; otherwise the first site-local IPv4 address found on an active, non-loopback interface is used. When several candidates exist the first is chosen and the alternatives are logged so a wrong pick can be overridden.

      Returns:
      the host address to advertise via RMI
      Throws:
      HostResolutionException - if no suitable address can be found or the network interfaces cannot be enumerated
